_doc: DEWY receipts for 2026-08-16 — capturing the ouroboros principle that surfaced while banking the Kam gauntlet session. See ADR-062 (recursive self-falsification) and witness stub _STATE/witness/2026-08-16.jsonl (F32 in the falsification ledger is the triggering event).

receipts.sharp_question: What makes a falsifier honest rather than propaganda wearing a lab coat?

dewy_vector.D: Canonize ADR-062: recursive self-application is the honesty test of any falsifier/audit/gauntlet/control. No self-exemption; turn the instrument on its own outputs; log self-catches as first-class falsifications; a surface that has never falsified one of its own designs has its external verdicts treated as unproven.
dewy_vector.E: The falsifier (gauntlet/claims-skeptic/provenance-checker), ADR-061, the honest-resonance-engine mission, the operator, the falsification ledger (F6, F32).
dewy_vector.W: Standing principle, effective now; a cheap per-control check going forward.
dewy_vector.Y: GREEN — twice demonstrated on the live tape: F6 (a GREEN ADR that exempted itself) and F32 (ADR-061 catching its own author on day one).

receipts.why: A falsifier that only points outward is indistinguishable from a flattering machine. The snake eating its own tail — the discipline catching its own author — is exactly the moment it proved real. Self-exemption is the tell of propaganda.
receipts.outcome: ADR-062 written + registered; witness stub filed (GREEN, promoted->ADR-062); grounded in F6 + F32 on the falsification ledger.
